about: Every environment variable the control plane reads that Terraform does not set, and why (build queue 2.1). Checked by scripts/deploy/check-terraform-env.mjs and volt-app/test/terraform-env.check.ts. A name ending in * covers every name with that start.

classes.default: The built-in default is right on AWS.
classes.local: Only for a Mac or a test run; leave it unset on AWS.
classes.operator: Set by whoever runs Volt when they use the feature, through app_env (plain) or app_secret_keys (secret, in the integrations secret).
classes.not-on-aws-yet: The feature does not work on AWS yet; the named build queue item fixes it.
